visualCharacteristics.purpose: Offer masthead with left-aligned eyebrow, heading, copy and CTA over a full-width background image (often an animated GIF carrying the offer artwork on the right)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Text column left over a full-bleed background image; image is cropped from the right edge so the artwork stays visible
visualCharacteristics.notes: Background image is kept as authored (not re-encoded) to preserve GIF animation and loaded eagerly as the LCP image.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image only; row 2: eyebrow paragraph, H1, intro paragraph (footnote sup allowed), CTA link. Either row may be omitted
rows: eyebrow paragraph, H1, body copy, CTA link

usage.description: Top-of-page masthead for promotional offer pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for any offer masthead with text over a background image. For a centered or text-over-photo hero without an offer layout, use the base hero.
